live_revalidation: 2026-09-09 SOURCECAL2A_CMFIX sidecar with requested physical camera 2 == capture-result camera 2 at 8.72 mm
stability_observation: The same two ColorMatrix values and the same ForwardMatrix values remain present in current live Camera2 characteristics. The earlier semantic A/D65 labels on the ColorMatrix pair were reversed; slot association is now authoritative.

historical_label_correction.correction_basis: Current direct Camera2 evidence reports referenceIlluminant1=21 with ColorMatrix1=0.8359375... and referenceIlluminant2=17 with ColorMatrix2=1.28125.... Android Camera2 defines transform slot 1 as belonging to illuminant slot 1 and slot 2 to illuminant slot 2; Android DngCreator preserves those slots when writing DNG tags.

current_main_rendering_impact: The corrected ColorMatrix semantic labels do not change the current main-sensor SOURCECAL2A final camera-to-XYZ-D50 transform when ForwardMatrix1 == ForwardMatrix2 and CalibrationTransform1 == CalibrationTransform2. They do correct interpolation/CCT interpretation and prevent a future unequal-endpoint lens from being wired backwards.
scope_warning: Main-camera source characterization only. Tele, super-tele and ultra-wide physical cameras still require independent controlled characterization before reuse.
